title: anthemis cretica subsp. pyrethriformis
intro: Anthemis cretica subsp. pyrethriformis, commonly known as a type of yarrow, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties and uses. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic effects. The therapeutic actions of Anthemis cretica subsp. pyrethriformis include soothing and calming effects, making it a popular natural remedy for stress relief and promoting a good night's sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpene lactones, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and uses.
